outside_sources.title: Blender Manual — Store Named Attribute Node
outside_sources.author: Blender Documentation Team

expert_notes: SplineParameter is a CURVE-domain field — it evaluates per control point on the curve, not per face or per instance; domain mismatch after CurveToPoints is the #1 failure mode
StoreNamedAttribute(name='vine_t', domain=POINT) freezes the field value before any downstream domain shift; InputNamedAttribute('vine_t') reads it back in any derived context
ResampleCurve(COUNT=64) is mandatory: raw Bezier control points are NOT uniformly spaced in arc-length parameter — Factor at unsampled points clusters near handles
The last resampled point sits at Factor=(N-1)/N ≈ 0.984, not 1.0; set LEAF_THRESHOLD < 0.984 to include the near-tip segment
CurveToPoints(LENGTH) mode gives uniform-density leaf placement regardless of local curve speed; COUNT mode would place more leaves on fast (stretched) sections
Leaf template object is intentionally unlinked from the scene — ObjectInfo(transform_space=ORIGINAL) accesses it via the data block without needing scene membership
export_apply=True is mandatory — runtimes do not evaluate GN modifiers; GLB must contain realised mesh data
vine_t named attribute is NOT exported by default; add export_attributes=True to include _VINE_T in the glTF binary accessor for custom shader use
